import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import test from 'node:test';
import {
  directoryMatchesBusiness,
  membershipNeedsFix,
  parseQaAccess,
  resolveDirectoryRiderIds,
  sanitizeMessage,
} from './validate-qa-runtime.mjs';

const BUSINESS_ID = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001';
const RIDER_ID = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002';

test('membership repair is exact and idempotent', () => {
  const valid = {
    business_id: BUSINESS_ID,
    user_id: RIDER_ID,
    role: 'rider',
    is_active: true,
  };
  assert.equal(membershipNeedsFix(valid, BUSINESS_ID, 'rider'), false);
  assert.equal(membershipNeedsFix({ ...valid, role: 'staff' }, BUSINESS_ID, 'rider'), true);
  assert.equal(membershipNeedsFix({ ...valid, is_active: false }, BUSINESS_ID, 'rider'), true);
  assert.equal(membershipNeedsFix(null, BUSINESS_ID, 'rider'), true);
});

test('directory validation uses the real rider_user_id field and rejects foreign rows', () => {
  const otherId = '00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000003';
  const rows = [{ rider_user_id: RIDER_ID, display_name: 'Rider QA' }];
  assert.deepEqual([...resolveDirectoryRiderIds(rows)], [RIDER_ID]);
  assert.equal(directoryMatchesBusiness(rows, new Set([RIDER_ID]), RIDER_ID), true);
  assert.equal(
    directoryMatchesBusiness([...rows, { rider_user_id: otherId }], new Set([RIDER_ID]), RIDER_ID),
    false,
  );
  assert.equal(directoryMatchesBusiness([{ user_id: RIDER_ID }], new Set([RIDER_ID]), RIDER_ID), false);
});

test('QA access parser keeps owner and rider credentials separated', () => {
  const parsed = parseQaAccess([
    `Business ID: ${BUSINESS_ID}`,
    '',
    'Owner QA',
    'Email: owner@example.invalid',
    'Password: owner-pass',
    '',
    'Rider QA',
    'Email: rider@example.invalid',
    'Password: rider-pass',
  ].join('\n'));
  assert.equal(parsed.ownerEmail, 'owner@example.invalid');
  assert.equal(parsed.riderEmail, 'rider@example.invalid');
});

test('sanitizer removes credentials, UUIDs, emails, and tokens', () => {
  const message = sanitizeMessage(
[EXCLUIDO: credencial/configuración; recrear localmente.]
  );
  assert.doesNotMatch(message, /sb_secret_|00000000|owner@|eyJabcdef/);
});

test('runtime validator creates four isolated clients with non-persistent auth', async () => {
  const source = await readFile(
    'C:\\1212\\taba-device-test-runtime\\validate-qa-runtime.mjs',
    'utf8',
  );
  assert.equal((source.match(/createIsolatedClient\(/g) || []).length, 5);
  assert.match(source, /persistSession:\s*false/);
  assert.match(source, /autoRefreshToken:\s*false/);
  assert.match(source, /detectSessionInUrl:\s*false/);
  assert.match(source, /\.rpc\('list_active_business_riders'/);
  assert.match(source, /row\?\.rider_user_id/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(source, /Authorization\s*:/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(source, /Bearer\s+/);
  assert.doesNotMatch(source, /admin\.createUser|admin\.deleteUser/);
});
